svg.title: Voltages in an RLC circuit compared with the current
svg.desc: Left, five graphs against time: the current I; V_R, in phase with I; V_L, leading I by a quarter cycle; V_C, lagging I by a quarter cycle; and their sum V. Dashed lines mark the times of a current maximum and minimum. Right: I and V together; the total voltage leads the current by a phase angle between 0 and 90°, here because V_L is larger than V_C.
